comparison.objective: Reorient cartons on moving carriers so labels face a scanner before reaching the gate.
comparison.physical_skill: Timed grasping and in-place object rotation on a moving line.
comparison.success_condition: Each carton is upright, released, carrier-supported, and correctly oriented at scan time without prior table contact.
comparison.reason: In-place rotation is a shared primitive, but carton orientation does not test locking, tool torque, or adjustment based on physical stopping behavior.
